questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about Network ACLs is true?
options: A. For security purposes, network ACLs only support deny rules.
B. An instance must have both a security group and a network ACL associated.
C. The larger the priority value, the lower the priority.
D. Network ACLs provide instance-level protection, so their rule configuration is more refined than that of a security group.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about public and private NAT gateways is false?
options: A. Public NAT gateways translate private IP into public IP.
B. A private NAT gateway can map a private IP to a transit IP through an SNAT rule.
C. Public NAT gateways can prevent private IPs of cloud servers from being exposed.
D. Both public and private NAT gateways can be configured with transit subnets to enable communications between networks with different IP ranges.

questions.prompt: EVS supports multiple data protection methods such as 3-copy redundancy and snapshots. Which of the following statements about EVS data protection is false?
options: A. EVS three-copy redundancy splits each piece of data into many 1 MiB data blocks; each data block is then replicated into three copies.
B. When standard snapshots are created for a disk, if the disk device type is SCSI, backup data will be stored in OBS. If the disk type is VBD, backup data will be stored locally on the disk.
C. EVS 3-copy redundancy stores data copies on different storage devices of storage nodes in the cluster based on a distributed storage algorithm.
D. Snapshots are used to back up data before high-risk operations or quickly restore data after misoperations or hacker attacks.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about changing RDS specs is false?

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about Cloud Firewall (CFW) is false?
options: A. CFW enables inter-VPC and global access control, combined with deep visibility and protection for internal service access traffic.
B. CFW protects the internet border and controls inbound traffic sent from the internet to cloud assets and outbound traffic sent from cloud assets to the internet.
C. CFW provides real-time intrusion detection and prevention, global unified access control, full traffic analysis, visualization, log audit, and source tracing analysis.
D. CFW automatically identifies and blocks network attacks including SQL injection, XSS, and web shell upload to protect the network border.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about Huawei Cloud AAD is false?
options: A. AAD not only protects Huawei Cloud hosts but also non-Huawei Cloud or IDC hosts.
B. CDN+AAD basic protection provides high-level basic network protection for cloud native users; it is suitable for security protection of cloud native service traffic.

D. CDN+AAD advanced protection provides you with minimum bandwidth as long as the peak attack traffic does not exceed the basic protection bandwidth you purchase.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a container runtime?
options: A. containerd
B. Podman
C. Hypervisor
D. Docker

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about Docker is false?
options: A. Docker uses a C/S architecture which supports multiple virtualization technologies. Traditional virtualization relies on hypervisors. Apps in Docker containers can be started in seconds compared to minutes for apps in traditional VMs. In addition, Docker containers use system resources more efficiently.
B. Docker is the first system that allows containers to be portable on different machines. It simplifies the packaging of both applications and their libraries and dependencies.
C. Docker containers virtualize resources at the system layer and share the OS of the host machine. Traditional virtualization happens at the hardware layer where an OS is virtualized.
D. Docker runs on the system isolation of the OS, even on VMs. Traditional virtualization is of physical resources and runs at the hardware level.

questions.prompt: A VPC peering connection is configured for two VPCs, but the ECSs in the VPCs cannot communicate with each other. Which of the following are possible causes?
options: A. The route destination of the VPC peering connection overlaps with that of a DC or VPN connection.
B. After a VPC peering connection is configured, only ECSs associated with it can communicate with each other.
C. Network parameters such as routes are incorrectly configured.
D. After a VPC peering connection is configured, it is disabled by default and must be manually enabled.

questions.prompt: Which of the following descriptions of ELB load balancing algorithms are true?
options: A. Weighted Round Robin: requests are forwarded to different backend servers based on weights that indicate their processing performance.
B. Weighted Least Connections: requests are hashed based on the source IP address, ensuring all requests from the same source IP are routed to the same backend server.
C. Source IP Hash: distributes requests to the backend with the smallest connections-to-weight ratio.
D. Connection ID: calculates the QUIC connection ID and routes requests with the same ID to the same backend server.

questions.prompt: Cloud Phone (CPH) is built on TaiShan servers that use ARM architecture. This reduces compute overhead caused by instruction set conversion when apps are developed to run on cloud phones, providing a better user experience.

BMS are provisioned in a self-service manner after you specify the server type, image, network, and other required info. BMSs can be provisioned in seconds. BMSs are configured with SDI cards so only an image with an SDI driver can be used to install a BMS OS.
Both public and private NAT gateways can be configured with transit subnets to enable communications between networks with different IP address ranges.

An Enterprise Router can have different types of network instances attached and features powerful scalability and link reliability. It is suitable for complex cloud architectures. It uses Border Gateway Protocol to learn routes and dynamically select or switch between connections. This improves network scalability, O&M, and service continuity.
Beyond public and private DNS resolution, DNS also supports query logging and auditing. Users can query, audit, and backtrack DNS views or export any query logs.

DSS provides highly available, user-exclusive, high-performance file storage that can be scaled on demand and comes with various specs. DSS storage pool resources are physically isolated and can be interconnected with different types of compute services. In addition, data encryption is enabled for system disks and data disks by default, and user data security is ensured by multiple measures.

If a DB instance handles many read requests but only a few writes, you can create one or more read replicas in a region to handle the extra read pressure. Once read replicas are created, read and write requests are split: read replicas only handle read requests and primary instances only handle write requests. This greatly reduces the load on the instance.

DBSS provides database audit, DB encryption, access control, and DB O&M functions. It records user access to the DB in real time, generates fine-grained reports, and reports real-time alarms when attacks or risky operations are detected.

CBH is a unified security platform. It supports SSO, vulnerability detection, unified asset management, baseline check, and webpage tamper protection. CBH uses a protocol-based forward proxy and remote access isolation, and provides a unified O&M login portal to enable centralized management and O&M of cloud resources such as servers, cloud hosts, DBs, and app systems.

Kubernetes is a core open source project of the Apache community. It provides scheduling, deployment, running, service discovery, grayscale releases, and development for containerized microservices throughout their entire lifecycle. Kubernetes has become the de facto industry standard for container and serverless technologies.

With FunctionGraph, you only need to configure and manage servers. You do not need to edit code or set running conditions. FunctionGraph automatically and efficiently executes functions based on preset service scenarios.
CSE allows O&M personnel to focus on service platform development and management, improving product delivery efficiency and quality.
Istio is better able to resolve issues in cloud native service management, network connection, security management, and other service network governance scenarios.

ServiceStage supports Java, Go, PHP, Node.js, and Python. It is compatible with native ServiceComb, Spring Cloud, and Dubbo/Mesh. It also supports code commit, check, build, deployment, and release, streamlining the software development process.
Self-service and elasticity are basic features of cloud computing.
Both customers and cloud vendors are responsible for O&M under the shared responsibility model.
Increasing system architecture complexity will challenge O&M.

APM allows setting alarm rules for critical cloud services. When the condition of an alarm rule is met, multi-channel notifications including email, SMS, and HTTP/HTTPS alert users immediately for timely handling.
COC supports deterministic Huawei Cloud features such as management and batch O&M, making cloud-based O&M more mature and secure with compliance.
ModelArts supports Kubernetes clusters.
Match the EVS performance indicators with their definitions.

pairs.label: Latency
pairs.text: Minimum interval between two consecutive read/write operations on an EVS disk.

pairs.label: Throughput
pairs.text: Amount of data read from and written to an EVS disk per second.

pairs.label: IOPS
pairs.text: Number of read/write operations performed by an EVS disk per second.
